CommunityApplications.Profile:
RifleJock's Unraid Community Apps repository.
**Plugins** - Storage Guard — free-space thresholds for array and pools; colors Main free bars and optional Unraid alerts. - Thunderbolt Net — host-to-host over TB3/4/5 and USB4/v2 (multi-peer tbn tabs, peers, services, honest trained rates; optional OpenFabric). - FRR (FRRouting) — optional FRR package/daemon manager for Unraid; standalone; pairs with Thunderbolt Net for multi-host OpenFabric.
Docker templates (Neos / Resonite headless) will return later.
Support: https://github.com/ibigsnet/unraid-templates
